correctness.rationale: Affine side-fraction reduction preserves the centroid and side-conditional distributions; exactly two conditional cases survive. The two-plus-one probability integrates to b=1/9+4 log(2)/27. A positive determinant and three mutually disjoint bad-sign events give c=2 log(2)/3. Exact multinomial counting yields the claimed polynomial. Positive coefficients imply strict Schur concavity, and the true Euclidean triangle domain p_i<1/2 yields both sharp endpoints. AM–GM and the e2 variance identity prove global stability. The packaged checker cross-checks equations, independent direct Euclidean containment, and finite balancing cases, without treating sampling as a proof.

value.rationale: A complete classification of the natural probability that three independently perimeter-sampled points capture their triangle’s area centroid, across every Euclidean triangle shape. It gives the exact two-parameter side-length law, strictly ordered shape transfers, unique equilateral optimum, only possible degenerate minimizers, entire attainable range and a global rigidity inequality. It separates the known area-uniform constant from the novel arclength shape dependence.
